name: Hotel Xcaret México
positioning: All-Fun Inclusive family resort on the Riviera Maya, born as a tribute to Mayan culture and Mexico, with suites looking out on jungle, river or sea and unlimited access to the Grupo Xcaret parks
best_for: Families who want spaces and activities for children and teenagers
Travelers who want unlimited access to the Grupo Xcaret parks included in their stay

facts.text: The hotel blends the beauty of its natural surroundings with its architecture.
Casa Fuego has an oceanfront location and two private pools.
Casa Agua is home to Muluk Spa.
Activities include gyms, paddle and tennis courts, an open-air functional training circuit, yoga lessons, meditation sessions and non-motorized water sports such as paddle board and kayak.
New Casas have spaces dedicated to children of all ages, teenagers and family activities.
Stays include a ferry to Cozumel and Isla Mujeres.
Bio is set in a natural cave overlooking the river and serves a plant-based menu by Chef Miguel Bautista.
Las Playas serves fresh grilled cuisine with your feet in the sand.

highlights.text: Casa Fuego has a translucent rooftop lap lane.
Suites look out on a natural landscape of jungle, river or sea.
The All-Fun Inclusive concept includes unlimited access to the parks Xcaret, Xel-Ha, Xplor, Xplor Fuego, Xoxi, Xenses and Xenotes.
Muluk Spa fuses ancient techniques with the latest skin-care products.
The hotel was born as a tribute to Mayan culture and to Mexico and its artisans.

considerations.text: WhataHotel notes it is a large resort property that requires walking between areas.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects its high-end all-inclusive positioning.
